title: YuE2 Studio: free Suno alternative
caption:
Suno charges $10/month to make songs with vocals. YuE2 Studio does it for free 🎵

✅ Write lyrics, pick a style, get a full song with vocals made on your own computer
✅ Editable sheet music: change the notes, tempo or key and render another take
✅ Covers: pick a recording and it sings the melody in a new style
✅ No subscription, no credits, 100% free

💻 Windows
ℹ️ It needs a Windows 10/11 PC with a GPU with 6 GB of VRAM or more (NVIDIA recommended; AMD and Intel are experimental), and a few GB of model downloads on first run. Suno's $10/month is the Pro plan billed monthly

Comment "SONG" and I'll DM you the link 🔗
